manifest.author: kody-w
manifest.description: Compiles caller-selected local RAPP agents into a provisioned, functionally parity-tested Copilot Studio Draft.
manifest.name: @kody-w/copilot_studio_parity_deploy

agents.description: Local RAPP tool names, class names, filenames, or agent paths. The caller must explicitly choose one or more agents for plan/deploy.

client_id.description: Optional public-client app ID for published-agent chat parity.

confirm_publish.description: Exact PUBLISH:<AgentId> token required by action=release.

display_name.description: Copilot Studio display name, max 30 characters.

dry_run.description: Build manifest/brief without init or push.

environment.description: Target Power Platform environment ID or URL.

infrastructure_manifest.description: Optional infrastructure manifest path under run_dir for action=provision.

output_root.description: Optional deployment root under the user's home.

parity_cases.description: Optional parity case file under run_dir.

principals.description: Team/systemuser principals to grant access before release.

entra_object_id.description: Entra object ID for non-owner profile proof.

project_dir.description: Existing Copilot Studio project for action=push.

reuse_parity.description: For finalize, reuse live parity evidence captured within 24 hours after revalidating all local and remote hashes.

verification_profile.description: Non-owner PAC auth profile used to prove list/clone access.
